description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application that demonstrates the use of RenderScript intrinsic features like blur, convolve, and color matrix filters. It manages UI components such as SeekBar and RadioButtons, initializes RenderScript objects, and performs image processing asynchronously to apply effects to images displayed in an ImageView.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity class demonstrating image processing with RenderScript, managing UI interactions, and applying different image effects asynchronously.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method initializing UI components, RenderScript, and starting initial image processing.

methods.name: createScript
methods.description: Initializes RenderScript context and allocates memory for images and intrinsic scripts.

methods.name: performFilter
methods.description: Applies the selected RenderScript intrinsic filter (blur, convolve, or color matrix) to input image data.

methods.name: getFilterParameter
methods.description: Converts UI slider progress (0-100) into appropriate parameter ranges for different filters.

methods.name: updateImage
methods.description: Manages asynchronous execution of image filtering and updates the UI upon completion.

methods.name: loadBitmap
methods.description: Loads a bitmap resource with preferred configuration.

methods.name: createThumbnail
methods.description: Generates small thumbnails for filter selection UI using RenderScript filters.
